one_line: Global regulators act, DeepMind resigns, OpenAI secures training, Block releases local voice model.

themes.title: Regulators tighten AI oversight worldwide
themes.text: The U.S. Treasury proposed expanding outbound investment restrictions on Chinese AI and biotech firms and extending the program to Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia. SEBI announced a graded broker compliance framework, an AI sandbox for testing tools, and a market‑making mechanism for tokenised corporate bonds.

stories.headline: US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms
SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon contract
themes.text: Google DeepMind research engineer Sofia Liguori left on Oct. 20 and AI researcher Andreas Kirsch resigned earlier in October, citing concerns about the company’s governance and oversight of its Pentagon AI contract.

stories.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns

themes.title: OpenAI adds security after training pause
themes.text: OpenAI used its Project Daybreak programme to help discover two critical PHP remote‑code‑execution bugs, and after fixing a configuration error and adding offline environments and high‑compute red‑team testing, resumed training of its most capable models on Oct. 1.

stories.headline: OpenAI’s Project Daybreak helps uncover critical PHP RCE bugs
OpenAI resumes training of frontier AI models after security overhaul

themes.title: Block unveils local full‑duplex voice model
themes.text: Block released Dessa, a speech‑to‑speech model that can listen and speak simultaneously and runs on consumer‑grade GPUs such as a MacBook M4 Max.

stories.headline: Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally
